brandCapRates.structure: Single marketed offering, Midwest City OK

brandCapRates.brand: Franchisee QSR (KFC, Wingstop, Bojangles, Church's, Slim Chickens, Golden Chick and peers)

leaseIntel.label: Chick-fil-A
leaseIntel.text: 20-year corporate absolute-NNN ground lease is standard; the record-setting Hixson TN deal was a shorter 15-year term with 10% increases every five years and ten 5-year options.

leaseIntel.label: Raising Cane's
leaseIntel.text: Typically a 20-year absolute-NNN ground lease with 10% rent increases every five years, corporate guaranteed — landlord has no roof, structure, parking or management obligation.

leaseIntel.label: Popeyes
leaseIntel.text: 15–20 year initial terms with 7.5%–10% rent bumps every five years; historical pricing band roughly $1.2M–$4.1M per asset.

leaseIntel.label: Dave's Hot Chicken
leaseIntel.text: New-construction drive-thru prototypes on 15-year absolute-NNN leases with 10% increases every five years.

leaseIntel.label: Credit spread
leaseIntel.text: The corporate-to-franchisee QSR spread stood at 100 basis points in Q2 2026 (5.85% vs 6.85%). Short-term, non-rated restaurant tenants can trade 200–300 bps wider than premium ground leases.

supply.label: KFC
supply.text: 312 U.S. closures in the twelve months to July 2026 (-7.64% of the footprint); 161 closures in calendar 2025 against 15 openings.

supply.label: Popeyes
supply.text: Roughly 33 Sailormen locations went dark through lease rejection in the 2026 Chapter 11 across Florida and Georgia.

supply.label: Hooters
supply.text: Roughly 30 restaurants closed effective June 4, 2025 across FL, GA, MI, NC, SC, TN and TX — large-format casual-dining pads, 4,500–6,500 SF.

supply.label: Church's Texas Chicken
supply.text: 12 units ceased operations in 2025 (after 20 in 2024 and nine the year prior), plus one franchise termination and one corporate closure.

supply.label: Jollibee
supply.text: More than 200 stores closed group-wide in the first half of 2026 with the 2026 opening target cut to 1,000–1,100.

marketConditions.text: Single-tenant property supply jumped 12.5% quarter-over-quarter in Q2 2026 to nearly 5,800 available properties, with retail listings up 16.2%.

Boulder Group's Q1 2026 Net Lease Tenant Profiles report covered 87 tenants with asking cap rates as of March 2026, ranging from 4.30% for 15-year McDonald's ground leases to 9.00%+ for short-term Walgreens.
Four Corners Property Trust acquired 33 properties for $85.5M in the first half of 2026 (10 for $26.8M in Q1, 23 for $57.2M in Q2).
